title: Measures that agree on the open subsets of an open set O, one of them finite on compact subsets of O, agree on all Borel subsets of O
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let O ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let μ, ν be measures on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^P (Mathlib Measure (Euclid P)). Assume that μ(C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ O, and that μ(G) = ν(G) for every open G ⊆ O. Then μ(A) = ν(A) for every Borel set A ⊆ O.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen O → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ O → μ C ≠ ∞) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → G ⊆ O → μ G = ν G) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ O → μ A = ν A
